column4: dialect-gated: cleat#3729 measurement, SQL Server arm of the version-scope test (the PostgreSQL arm is engine/a_store_sees_only_its_own_tenants_versions_test.go and the cleat-worker/cleatctl call-site tests). This job (./cmd/..., CLEAT_TEST_DB only) supplies no SQL Server, so exactly this function skips. It FAILS rather than skips when CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL is set and the server is unreachable (mssqlHBRig pings it). Measured by name: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./cmd/cleat-worker/ -run TestASQLServerStoreSeesOnlyItsOwnTenantsVersions -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly this one.
